agent_evaluations.detailed_feedback: This MCQ set has CRITICAL systematic failures across all 65 questions that make it unsuitable for AMC Clinical Examination preparation without complete regeneration. The most severe issues: (1) ZERO RAG citations - all 65 questions show 'Unknown' sources with rag_confidence 0.0, violating the zero-hallucination requirement. Every clinical fact must be traceable to Qdrant database with confidence ≥0.65. (2) MASSIVE duplication - 8 unique questions repeated 9 times each (72 duplicates out of 65 questions). (3) Incomplete educational content - 'why_incorrect' explanations are placeholder text ('Incorrect - [option]'), key_points arrays are empty, and single-sentence explanations lack clinical depth. (4) Missing Australian clinical standards - no SAFE-T protocol detail, no Mental Health Act state specification, no Australian crisis contacts (Lifeline/Beyond Blue), no cultural safety elements. (5) No QA validation - qa_validated: false means content bypassed the mandatory 13-gate quality system. This appears to be template-generated content (metadata shows 'template_variant') that was never reviewed by a clinical expert. To meet production standards: regenerate all content with RAG system enabled, ensure 65 unique questions, complete all explanation fields with clinical reasoning, add SAFE-T/Mental Health Act detail, include Australian context (MBS/PBS/crisis contacts), and pass 13-gate QA validation. Current state: 2.0/10 (catastrophic failure). Target: ≥8.0/10 with 100% citation coverage and zero duplicates.
